mode.title: Imodi yevidiyo
mode.soloHint: I-avatar ikhuluma wonke umbhalo, nevidiyo yakho eceleni. Inketho elula kakhulu.
mode.retentionHint: Izithombe zishintsha njalo ngemizuzwana embalwa kuthrekhi yezwi elilodwa, kugcina ababukeli bematasa. 'Isithombe sami' kuphela esitholakalayo.
mode.dialogueHint: Abantu ababili bakhuluma esikrinini. Kudinga izithombe ezimbili nokuqoshwa kwamazwi amabili.
mode.presetEcoHint: Izithombe eziseduze ezibizayo kuphela zokubamba nokubiza isenzo (~2 ngevidiyo). Ethengeka kakhulu.
mode.presetBalHint: Izithombe eziseduze zokubamba, isenzo, nokubiza isenzo (~3). Indawo enhle kakhulu.
mode.presetPremHint: Isikhathi esiphezulu sobuso (~4 izithombe eziseduze). Iguquguquka kakhulu futhi iyi-premium.
mode.presetAiTrailer: I-AI inquma izinhlobo zezithombe ngokusekelwe kumbhalo.
mode.engEcoHint: Cishe njalo isikhulumi esisodwa esikrinini. Inketho ethengeka kakhulu.
mode.engBalHint: Isithombe esiseduze sesikhulumi; bobabili esikrinini ukuze bathole ukusabela nezindawo eziphakeme.
mode.engDynHint: Izindawo eziningi 'bobabili esikrinini' nezithombe ezifakiwe. Iguquguquka kakhulu futhi iyi-premium.
mode.cutoutSub: Umuntu kuphela ohlala kuhlaka — ukuze uthole isakhiwo 'ingemuva, i-avatar eceleni'.
mode.voiceoverHint: Ividiyo yakho + izwi: I-AI text-to-speech (ElevenLabs) noma ukuqoshwa kwakho. I-HeyGen ayisetshenziswa — cishe mahhala. Izithombe ezifakiwe zokuzikhethela zengxoxo.

avatar.title: I-avatar
avatar.empty: Iqoqo alinalutho. Khiqiza ama-avatar alungile noma engeza izithombe kusuka kugalari yakho.
avatar.briefPlaceholder: Chaza i-avatar: 'Owesifazane oneminyaka engu-25, ojwayelekile, onobungane'…
avatar.photoHint: Isithombe sobuso obugcwele. I-HeyGen izokwenza isithombe siphile, ivumelanise izindebe nezinkulumo nezwi.
avatar.extIntro: Amakhanda ahlelwa isandiso kuthebhu yakho ye-app.heygen.com nge-subscription (ishibhile kathathu kune-API).
avatar.extKeepOpen: Gcina ithebhu ye-HeyGen studio ivuliwe nge-subscription esebenzayo.
avatar.apiNote: Nge-HeyGen API — key ku-Settings → Generation, pay-as-you-go (~$3/min Avatar IV).

avatar.videoLocked: Ividiyo erekhodiwe ngaphambilini — kuphela kumodi 'yesethuli esisodwa'
avatar.videoHint: Ividiyo erekhodiwe ngaphambilini nomuntu okhulumayo — inkulumo nokubonakaliswa kobuso sekuvele kufakiwe. I-HeyGen ne-voiceover azisetshenziswa: kuyashesha futhi akukho zindleko zokukhiqiza.
avatar.videoCutoutHint: Uma ividiyo inesikrini esiluhlaza, sizosika bese sibeka isithunzi phezu kwevidiyo.
avatar.aiCutoutHint: I-HeyGen izohlela isithombe ngemuva okuluhlaza, isevisi izosisusa — kuzosala isithunzi somuntu kuphela esikrinini, ngaphandle kwebhokisi.

voice.dialogueNeedsRecording: Ingxoxo idinga ukurekhodwa kwamazwi amabili — shintshela ku-'Okurekhodiwe yimi' bese uhlaziya inkulumo.

analysis.pickSub: Ukuhlaziya okulondoloziwe okuvela ekhasini 'Lamathrendi'. Ukuhlaziya okukhethiwe kuhlanganiswe kumabhulokhi esitudiyo; sebenzisa amabhokisi okuhlola ukuze unqume ukuthi kuphi.

tpl.tooltip: Izifanekiso: londoloza zonke izilungiselelo zesitudiyo futhi unike amandla ukushicilela okuzenzakalelayo kwamathrendi
tpl.title: Izifanekiso ze-UGC
tpl.sub: Isifanekiso sigcina ZONKE izilungiselelo zesitudiyo (imodi, imibhalo engezansi, umculo, amabhokisi okuhlola okuhlaziya). 'Ukushicilela okuzenzakalelayo' kuxhumanisa isifanekiso nokuhlaziya okuzenzakalelayo komkhuba, kuhlanganisa amavidiyo ngokuzenzakalelayo.
tpl.empty: Awekho izifanekiso okwamanje. Londoloza izilungiselelo zakho zamanje ngezansi.
tpl.autopubHint: Ukuhlaziya okuzenzakalelayo kuthola amavidiyo wamathrendi amasha, kuwahlaziye, bese kukhiqiza ividiyo kusetshenziswa lesi sifanekiso (kufolda 'Okuzenzakalelayo' kuGalari). Eminye imithombo izongezwa kamuva.
tpl.noWatches: Akukho ukuhlaziya okuzenzakalelayo okwamanje. Kwenze kusebenze ekhasini 'Amathrendi' (esigabeni 'Ukuhlaziya okuzenzakalelayo').
tpl.note: Izifanekiso zibonakala kuGalari → UGC → 'Okuzenzakalelayo' ngamavidiyo akhiqizwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.

billing.faq49A1: Ekuphumeni kufanele uqinisekise ikhadi lasebhange nge-Stripe — kuyadingeka, kodwa akukho okukhokhiswayo izinsuku ezi-7 futhi uthola ukufinyelela okugcwele. Lapho isivivinyo siphela, i-€49/ngenyanga ikhokhwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Khansela ngaphambi kokuba kuphele izinsuku ezi-7 futhi ngeke ukhokhiswe nhlobo.
billing.faq49A2: I-autopilot shell: ukusesha amathrendi nokuhlaziya, ukuqondisa izithameli, i-UGC studio, isandiso se-Chrome, umshicileli onecebo lokuqukethwe, i-autopilot negalari. Ukukhiqizwa kwe-AI ngokwayo akufakiwe — kusebenza ngezibhaliso zakho (Google Flow, NotebookLM, HeyGen) noma izinkinobho zakho ze-API, futhi ukhokha abahlinzeki ngqo ngamanani abo.
billing.faq49A3: Abahlinzeki bathengisa amakhredithi okubhalisa ashibhile kakhulu kunezikweletu ezifanayo nge-API: i-Veo ekubhaliseni kwe-Google AI ishibhile ngo-2–10×, ama-avatar e-HeyGen ashibhile ngo-3×. Futhi i-NotebookLM ayinayo i-API yomphakathi nhlobo — ukubhalisa kuphela. Isandiso senza umsebenzi ngaphakathi kwama-akhawunti akho, sikunikeza ukusebenziseka okufana ne-API ngamanani okubhalisa. Izinombolo eziqondile zikule thebula nekhalculator ngenhla.
billing.faq49A4: Ezimbili zanele ukuqala: Google AI Pro (€21.99/ngenyanga — ividiyo ye-Flow + NotebookLM enemikhawulo ephakeme) kanye ne-HeyGen Creator ($29/ngenyanga — cishe imizuzu engama-30 ye-Avatar IV). Yonke insizakalo inemikhawulo yamahhala (Flow — amakhredithi angama-50/ngosuku, NotebookLM — izifinyezo ezi-3/ngosuku, HeyGen — amavidiyo ama-3/ngenyanga), ukuze ukwazi ukuzama ipayipi ngaphandle kwezibhaliso nhlobo.
billing.faq49A5: Yebo. Xhuma izinkinobho zakho (Google Veo, FAL/Kling, Runway, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Claude) kuzilungiselelo futhi insizakalo ikhiqiza ngazo ngqo, akukho sandiso esidingekayo. Ukhokha lezo zinsizakalo ngamanani azo. Izindlela zixubana ngokukhululeka: ama-avatar ekubhaliseni, i-voice-over nge-API, isibonelo.
billing.faq49A6: Phezulu kuleli khasi, ekhadini elithi “Uhlelo lwakho”, inkinobho ethi “Vala ukuvuselela okuzenzakalelayo” iyavela ngenkathi okubhaliselwe kusebenza. Izikhathi ezikhokhelwe azibuyiselwa, kodwa ukufinyelela kuhlala kuze kuphele isikhathi. Kuvale ngesikhathi sokuzama futhi ngeke ukhokhiswe nhlobo. landing.featByokText: Ibhizinisi le-BYOK: Xhuma ukhiye wakho we-Google API futhi ubambe imihlangano, ukhokhe kuphela ingqalasizinda ngentengo.
landing.featIntro: I-VibeVox isebenza ngqo kusiphequluli sakho. Dala igumbi lomhlangano ngokuchofoza oku-1, kopisha isixhumanisi, bese usithumela koxhumana naye ku-WhatsApp noma ku-Telegram — baxhuma ngokushesha, futhi bobabili bezwana behunyushelwa olimini lwabo lwendabuko. Akukho ukubhaliswa okudingekayo kumlingani wakho.
landing.featLearnText: I-AI Learning Hub ijwayela amagama akho akhethekile kanye nezilimi zesifunda ezingama-96 — isi-Arabhu saseGibhithe, iSpanishi saseLatin America. Ngomzuzu owodwa nje wokusebenzisa.
landing.featPriceText: Intengo ephansi kakhulu emakethe yokuhumusha ngesikhathi esisodwa. Khokha kuphela ngemizuzu ehunyushiwe — akukho okubhaliselwe noma inkontileka yonyaka.
landing.featRolloverText: Ibhalansi engasetshenziswanga idluliselwa ngokuzenzakalelayo enyangeni elandelayo. Uma isikhokhiwe, imizuzu ingeyakho ngaphandle komnqamulajuqu.
landing.featShareText: Thumela isixhumanisi nge-WhatsApp noma i-Telegram — oxhumana naye uxhuma ngqo kusiphequluli sakhe. Akukho App Store, umnyango we-IT, noma ukusetha. Isebenza kunoma iyiphi idivayisi.
landing.featVoiceText: Amazwi e-HD i-Aoede ne-Charon. I-Gemini ihumusha umsindo ngqo kumsindo — akukho uchungechunge lwe-STT→umbhalo→TTS. Ukubambezeleka okungaphansi kuka-0.5 isekhondi, ingxoxo ihamba ngokwemvelo.
landing.finalSub: Bhalisa ngomzuzu. Izinsuku eziyisi-7 zokuqala mahhala.
landing.heroLead: Ukuhumusha okusheshayo kwezindlela ezimbili kwemihlangano yevidiyo namakholi e-SIP ngezilimi ezingaphezu kwezi-100. Amazwi e-HD, ukubambezeleka okungaphansi kuka-0.5 isekhondi, €0.17 nje ngomzuzu.
landing.hintsText: Ku-SIP telephony, i-AI ibhala ingxoxo ngesikhathi sangempela futhi ibonise izimpendulo ezilungiselelwe kumphathi. Ngemuva kocingo — izindawo ezibuhlungu, izimbangela, namathegi ziya ngokuzenzakalelayo ku-CRM (Chatwoot, Questflow). Xhuma ku-Zadarma, Twilio, nanoma iyiphi i-SIP gateway.
landing.langsText: Ukhuluma ulimi lwakho — oxhumana naye uzwa ukuhumusha kolwakhe. Uyaphendula — umuzwa ngokushesha ngo-{{lang}}. Ngokuvumelanayo, ngaphandle kokubambezeleka, ngaphandle kwe-accent.
landing.metaDesc: I-TrendTraffic — thola izitayela ezisakazwa kakhulu ku-TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, naku-X, ukuhlaziya imithombo yezokuxhumana, ukuhlanganisa nokukhiqiza amavidiyo.
landing.noBurnText: Nge-SaaS yakudala, imizuzu engasetshenziswanga iyaphelelwa yisikhathi njalo ngenyanga. I-VibeVox iyidlulisela ngokucophelela enyangeni elandelayo — awulahlekelwa umzuzwana wesikhathi esikhokhiwe.

Kunconywa i-akhawunti ehlukile enephlani le-Google AI (Plus/Pro/Ultra): imikhawulo yansuku zonke ye-NotebookLM (umsindo/ividiyo/ingxoxo) ibalwa nge-akhawunti ngayinye. Inkundla ayiwagcini amakhukhi akho e-Google — ukungena kwakho kuhlala kusiphequluli sakho.

ttLanding.f1Text: Skena amapulatifomu amathathu ngendawo nangendawo. "Ukukhomba izethameli": chaza umkhiqizo wakho — i-AI izogcwalisa ngokuzenzakalelayo izethameli, ikhethe amagama angukhiye ngezilimi ezingu-29, futhi ithole izindawo ezinemfuno yangempela. Iziteshi zabancintisana nabo ohlwini lokubuka ngomlando wamamethrikhi.
ttLanding.f2Text: Namathisela isixhumanisi kunoma iyiphi ividiyo ye-TikTok, Instagram, noma YouTube — i-Gemini izoyihlukanisa uhlaka ngohlaka: ihuku, isigqi, isakhiwo, amazwibela. Ukuhlukaniswa namazwibela kuzoya egalari, futhi i-"TrendDNA" izoqondisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ividiyo yakho yesikhathi esizayo.
ttLanding.f3Text: Izindlela ezine: eyedwa, ingxoxo yabantu ababili, umbhalo wakho "njengoba unjalo", isiqondiso esisekelwe ekuhlaziyweni kwezitayela. Ukubukeka kwe-HeyGen okulungile noma i-avatar kusuka esithombeni sakho, wonke amazwi e-ElevenLabs kuhlanganise nama-clone, izitayela zamazwibela abukhoma, namakhithi omkhiqizo.
ttLanding.f4Text: Ukuqapha izitayela kuguqula okutholakele kube amavidiyo alungile asekelwe kuthempulethi yakho. Amaketanga okushicilela ngokuzenzakalelayo asabalalisa amafomethi kuwo wonke amapulatifomu nezikhala — i-TikTok, YouTube, ne-Instagram zithola okuqukethwe ngesikhathi.

ttLanding.priceBody: I-Premium — ukufinyelela okugcwele kuwo wonke amamojula. Izinsuku eziyi-7 zokuqala mahhala, akukho zindleko, khansela noma nini.
ttLanding.savBody: Isandiso sethu se-Chrome sixhuma izinsizakalo ze-AI sisebenzisa okubhaliselwe kwakho okukhona esikhundleni sokukhokhiswa kwezikweletu ze-API. Futhi okhiye bakho (BYOK) — Gemini, ElevenLabs, TikHub, Blotato — basebenza ngokuqondile, ngaphandle kokumaka okumaphakathi.
ttLanding.stBody: Ukusesha izitayela, ukuhlaziya amavidiyo asakazwayo, ama-avatar, ama-voiceover, imibhalo engezansi, amavidiyo akhiqizwa ngokuzenzakalelayo, nokuthunyelwa okuzenzakalelayo—konke endaweni eyodwa. Xhuma okhiye bakho besevisi noma okubhaliselwe kwakho bese ukhokha ngendlela ekongela kakhulu.
ttLanding.step1Text: Isithwebuli sethu sihlanganisa i-TikTok, i-Instagram, ne-YouTube ngokusekelwe ku-niche yakho, isifunda, nolimi. I-AI targeter yethu ikhomba ama-micro-niche namagama angukhiye, iwalinganise ngesidingo sangempela.
ttLanding.step2Text: I-Gemini analytics ihlukanisa amavidiyo asakazwayo abe ama-hook, isigqi, nesakhiwo. Uthola i-TrendDNA—iresiphi yesitudiyo sakho sevidiyo, kanye nemibhalo engezansi yoqobo.
ttLanding.step3Text: Isitudiyo sethu se-UGC sidala amavidiyo e-AI avatar: ukubukeka osekulungile noma i-avatar evela esithombeni sakho, amazwi e-ElevenLabs ngezilimi ezingu-29, ama-cut-ins, imibhalo engezansi, nekhithi yomkhiqizo. Amafomethi 9:16 no-16:9.
ttLanding.step4Text: I-Autopilot iqapha izitayela futhi ihlanganise amavidiyo isebenzisa izifanekiso, kuyilapho i-Publisher ihlela ukuthi athunyelwe ezinsukwini ezingu-35 kusengaphambili: 9:16 ye-TikTok, 16:9 ye-YouTube.

storyboard.asmIntro: Izingxenye eziqediwe zihlanganiswa ngokulandelana, zinebheji phezulu futhi (ngokuzikhethela) imibhalo engezansi. Umphumela uya kuGalari → "Amafayela emidiya" futhi ulungele Umshicileli.
storyboard.costNote: Injini yesofthiwe ayisebenzisi okhiye bangaphandle. Ukuloba — isicelo esingu-1 se-Gemini; uhlelo lwephaneli ye-AI — isicelo esingu-1 se-Claude (okhiye ku-Izilungiselelo).

storyboard.genIntro: Ukuqondiswa kwephayiphi: isiqephu 1 kuqala. Hlola umphumela — okunye kuzovuleka. Injini yesofthiwe ihlela ngamaphaneli: ukusondeza, izihloko, okufakiwe, isikrini esihlukanisiwe.
storyboard.imgPickNote: Isithombe-skrini sezibalo, isithombe somkhiqizo, noma igrafu kuzovela njengokufakiwe/ukuhlukanisa/ukulingisa kwale phaneli.

storyboard.pngHint: Hlola ngokubonakalayo: imibhalo ayinamaphutha, amafreyimu angawakho — kushibhile ukubamba izinkinga lapha kunasemva kokukhiqiza.
storyboard.replanHint: Yakha kabusha amaphaneli azo zonke iziqephu ngomqondisi we-AI (ukuhlelwa kombhalo okwenziwa ngesandla kuzobhalwa phezu kwakho)

storyboard.tabIntro: Hlela ngokuzenzakalelayo ama-Reels kusuka kuvidiyo ekhulumayo: loba → storyboard enamaphaneli angu-6 isiqephu ngasinye → khiqiza bese uhlanganisa. Thatha okwakho kuGalari noma layisha kusuka kudivayisi yakho.

storyboard.trIntro: I-Gemini ihlaziya yonke ividiyo: inkulumo eqondile enezikhathi + izigcawu zangempela. Bese ividiyo isikwa ibe izingxenye ezifika kumasekhondi angu-8 ekugcineni kwemisho, futhi kwakhiwe i-storyboard ngayinye.
storyboard.trNoAiHint: Ayikho ikhi ye-Gemini: ngisho nezingxenye ezingama-8s, amaphaneli wethempulethi
storyboard.stripHint: I-filmstrip yengxenye. Chofoza uhlaka ukuze ulunikeze iphaneli ekhethiwe (okwamanje: {{n}}). Khetha iphaneli ngokuchofoza ikhadi layo noma umugqa onemibala.
storyboard.attachNote: Khetha isiqeshana esigcinwe isandiso kusuka ku-Google Flow ("KuGalari"). Sizosiguqula sibe ifomethi yengxenye bese sibeka izwi langempela phezu kwaso.
storyboard.genIntroFlow: Injini ye-Flow (okuzenzakalelayo): landa izinto zengxenye, yenza ku-Google Flow (Omni Flash, 9:16, "gcina umsindo wangempela"), gcina isiqeshana "KuGalari" ngesandiso — bese usinamathisela lapha. Sizobeka izwi lengxenye phezu kwaso.
storyboard.genIntroOmni: Injini ye-Omni Flash: ukukhiqizwa okukodwa ngengxenye — uhlaka lokuqala "luphila" ngokwe-prompt yephaneli, ngezwi lakho langempela libekwe phezu kwalo. Izindleko ≈$1/ingxenye (~10s × $0.10) kusuka kukhi yakho ye-Gemini. Ingxenye 1 kuqala!
storyboard.autoAssemble: Hlanganisa ividiyo ngokuzenzakalelayo lapho zonke izingxenye sezilungile
storyboard.flowActiveHint: Ulayini we-Flow uyasebenza — gcina ithebhu ye-labs.google/…/flow ivuliwe. Izimo zibuyekezwa ngokuzenzakalelayo.
storyboard.genIntroFlow2: Injini ye-Flow — OKUZENZAKALELAYO: vula i-labs.google → Flow kusiphequluli sakho ngesandiso se-TrendTraffic bese uchofoza inkinobho engezansi. Isandiso sizolayisha ngokuzenzakalelayo ingxenye ne-storyboard, sifake i-prompt, sikhiqize, bese sibuyisela isiqeshana — ingxenye ngengxenye, ngisho nevidiyo ende (umkhawulo we-Flow ~8s/isiqeshana, yingakho sisika sibe ngu-8s). Sizobeka izwi langempela phezu kwaso. Imodi yemanuwali — izinkinobho kumakhadi.
